problemDescription: Current Blending Feed Parameters (Controllable) are causing us to shift the process level away from center in reaction to special causes.
objective: Process will stay centered at target blend percentages for each component, blend integrity should improve. Stock-Prep is the customer.
proposedSPCSystemChange:
- Change Blending Feed Parameters (VST, KST, Bright Scrap, Burley Scrap, Class) from Controllable to Tracking
- Establish standards for weighbelt controller set points based on current blending output and blend percentages.
measurementsOfEffectiveness: Leave current Blending Feed TQM’s in place
X should be closer to target, variation should remain the same or decrease
actionPlan: Convert controllable parameters to tracking and implement new standards at 2300 on 11/28/89.
